SRC-401:R001.text: Do not assume these facts still describe the live repository.

SRC-401:R002.text: Their causal relationship to the observed final STATE must still be established through reproduction.

SRC-401:R003.text: Never convert an exception, omitted provider result or absent root into CLEAN_VERIFIED without an explicit contract proving that absence is valid.

SRC-401:R004.text: Determine the protocol-correct closure mode using actual review evidence.

SRC-401:R005.text: Permit automatic terminal completion where existing operator authority already permits it.

SRC-401:R006.text: Do not demand a manual confirmation solely to acknowledge that a completed automated verification found no defects, unless a genuine protected decision is involved.

SRC-401:R007.text: Preserve a distinct outcome for unresolved findings or required human decisions.

SRC-401:R008.text: Reconcile superseded review generations without deleting the older provenance.

SRC-401:R009.text: Keep package identity, role revision, immutable collect linkage and durable receipts intact.

SRC-401:R010.text: Never mark a package genuinely reviewed before its required independent Core review has happened.

SRC-401:R011.text: Never fabricate a patch or publication receipt merely to close a no-change review ticket.

SRC-401:R012.text: Do not manufacture grants, approve protected actions, bypass broker verification or reinterpret denied authority as consent.

SRC-401:R013.text: Avoid repeatedly filing identical protected-goal tickets.

SRC-401:R014.text: Do not automatically publish or amend foreign-owned changes.

SRC-401:R015.text: Do not infer publication merely from a successful test or DONE ticket.

SRC-401:R016.text: Goal loader raises an exception: must not report CLEAN_VERIFIED.

SRC-401:R017.text: Active Persistent Goal with empty BOARD: must not report ALL_WORK_COMPLETE.

SRC-401:R018.text: Authority-blocked maintenance: must not claim successful goal completion.

SRC-401:R019.text: Certificate failure must remain observable in structured status.

SRC-401:R020.text: Restart/recovery must preserve disposition and authorization provenance.

SRC-401:R021.text: All ordinary tests must be non-invasive to the active Windows desktop.

SRC-401:R022.text: Do not capture keyboard, mouse, focus or foreground windows.

SRC-401:R023.text: Do not claim success solely because the CLI reports DONE or the validator reports zero problems.

SRC-401:R024.text: Avoid duplicate tickets if the same fixes are already implemented.

SRC-401:R025.text: Do not halt unrelated permitted work.

SRC-401:R026.text: Never bypass safety gates to simulate autonomous progress.
